description: Add complex condition expressions to context trigger system
steps: In src/nexus/triggers/context_trigger.py, add condition expression dataclasses: ConditionExpression (base), AndCondition(conditions: list), OrCondition(conditions: list), NotCondition(condition), ThresholdCondition(metric: str, operator: str, value: float), TimeCondition(after: datetime|None, before: datetime|None, weekdays: list[int]|None)
Add evaluate_condition(expression: ConditionExpression, context: dict) -> bool recursive evaluator function that handles each condition type, with short-circuit evaluation for And/Or
Add ConditionBuilder class with fluent API: .and_(*conditions), .or_(*conditions), .not_(condition), .threshold(metric, op, value), .time(after, before, weekdays), .build() -> ConditionExpression
Keep existing ContextRule and ContextTriggerConfig fully working unchanged (backward compatible)

Create tests/test_context_trigger_conditions.py with tests covering: AndCondition evaluation, OrCondition evaluation, NotCondition, ThresholdCondition with various operators, TimeCondition with weekday/time ranges, nested conditions (And containing Or), short-circuit behavior, ConditionBuilder fluent API, backward compatibility of existing ContextRule
acceptance_criteria: pytest tests/test_context_trigger_conditions.py passes all new tests
evaluate_condition() correctly handles all 5 condition types recursively
ConditionBuilder produces valid expressions via fluent API
Existing ContextRule and DEFAULT_CONTEXT_TRIGGER unchanged and still importable
